text:
mike: FYI onboarding POC with NovaHealth — legal sent back an order form with a 'signer binding appendix' clause that procurement says will block signature routing if left as-is.

liz: can you paste the redline? i only saw the MSA/DPA changes earlier.

mike: attaching snippet we received from their counsel:

```
Signer Binding Appendix: Execution by an authorized representative constitutes binding acceptance. Signatures via electronic means (DocuSign, Adobe Sign) are acceptable. Any delegated signatory must be listed in Appendix A.
```

anya: this is too prescriptive. requiring Appendix A for delegated signers breaks standard PO workflows. propose language that recognizes a customer's internal delegation rather than mandating an appendix.

jordan: procurement also notes the order form lists billing email as billing@novah.com — need VAT details and billing contact for invoicing + PO mapping.

devon: POC ask: Nova wants Dedicated capacity during the trial and will only sign if we include Dedicated pricing on the order form. they also asked for SLA 99.95% for the trial window.

mike: 99.95% for a POC? we usually do 99.9% for hosted and have specific Guidance for Dedicated. can we make an exception for a time‑boxed POC? :thinking_face: 

anya: legal won't approve a blanket higher SLA unless the infra team certifies Dedicated pool can meet that SLO. alternative: offer a POC SLA target of 99.9% with capped service credits and a defined escalation path in Console. also require completion of the security questionnaire before go-live.

liz: signature routing question — Nova uses DocuSign with conditional signers and requires the customer's signature on the order form before countersigning. will that block our standard send-first flow?

jordan: finance can accept e-signature as long as we have a procurement confirmation email that shows the authorized signer. if they insist on customer-first countersignature, we need to confirm invoice timing.

mike: action items:
- @anya: provide alternate clause text by EOD
- @devon: confirm Dedicated pool availability and pricing delta
- @jordan: collect billing contact, VAT, and PO instructions from customer
- @liz: test DocuSign send flow with conditional signers

anya: suggested redline (draft):
"Authorized Signatory: This Agreement may be executed electronically or in counterparts by authorized representatives of each party. Each party represents that signatures delivered electronically or by PDF are binding, and each party's internal delegation of signature authority is deemed sufficient without requiring a separate appendix listing delegates."

devon: that wording addresses the appendix issue. capacity note: Dedicated pool available for a 30‑day POC at +25% over hosted unit price. need SRE capacity confirmation for the exact window.

mike: i'll loop in @sre-capacity separately to lock capacity. i'll also prep a pricing addendum and send a test DocuSign envelope once legal signs off. dropping copy of customer purchase intent email: link.redacted

docsign-bot: envelope 0x9e4 created for novah-poc-orderform — awaiting signer 1 (customer)

mike: ping @anya — can we ship the redline as-is and send to customer for acceptance, or any tweaks?

anya: ok from legal if we remove the Appendix A requirement and add a 30‑day notice clause for changes to delegated signatories; include the POC SLA language and cap on credits.

liz: sending a test envelope now, will report back in ~20m :thumbsup:
